adjudication.rationale: In the migration `CreateTopicEmbeds`, `embed_url` is declared as `t.string :embed_url, null: false` with no explicit limit. In Rails/ActiveRecord, `:string` maps to a bounded `varchar` with a default limit (commonly 255), not an “unbounded varchar”. Therefore the claim that very long URLs could exceed a btree index tuple size limit due to an unbounded column is not supported by the diff (the more immediate constraint would be the column’s own length limit, not the index tuple limit).
